Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations offset the recent price pullback.

Silver.note: Industrial demand weakness and a significant recent price correction weigh on the outlook.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and electrification demand outweigh near-term macro headwinds.

Uranium.note: Persistent primary supply deficits and a renewed global nuclear capacity build-out.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing electric vehicle battery demand growth.

Nickel.note: Surging Indonesian supply and shifting battery chemistry preferences depress prices.

Zinc.note: Tight concentrate markets and smelter treatment charge squeezes support prices.

Iron Ore.note: Chinese property sector weakness offsets resilient infrastructure steel demand.

Coal.note: Peaking thermal demand offsets steady metallurgical coal pricing.

Rare Earths.note: Weak near-term demand balances against Chinese supply restrictions.

Manganese.note: Steady steel production maintains baseline demand without major catalysts.

PGM.note: Hydrogen economy upside potential offsets near-term auto production softness.

Potash.note: Balanced global fertilizer application rates and normalized supply chains.

Aluminum.note: Tight primary metal markets and rising green energy demand support premiums.

Diversified.note: Broad portfolio exposure balances sector-specific bull and bear trends.
